title: Show fractions greater than 1 with models and name them as mixed or improper

lesson.title: More Than One Whole: Two Names, One Amount

steps.say: You already know a fraction means one whole cut into equal parts, like one pizza cut into four equal slices. But what if you have more pizza than one whole? Today we learn how to name that amount.

visual.caption: One whole pizza, cut into four equal quarters

steps.say: At the pizza party you have one whole pizza plus three more quarter slices from a second pizza. Look at the two pizzas. The first one is completely shaded, and the second one has three of its four slices shaded.

visual.caption: One whole pizza and three quarters of another

steps.say: Here is the same amount shown as bars. Now let's just count quarter pieces. Four quarters in the first bar, plus three quarters in the second bar, makes seven quarters altogether. So we can also call it seven quarters.

visual.caption: Counting the shaded pieces: four quarters plus three quarters is seven quarters

steps.say: So the very same pizza has two names. When we say one and three quarters, that is called a mixed number, because it mixes a whole number with a fraction. When we say seven quarters, that is called an improper fraction, because the top number is bigger than the bottom number.

visual.caption: One point marked on the line, with two names: seven quarters and one and three quarters

steps.say: Now here is a mistake I see a lot. Some kids read one and three quarters as two separate numbers, like the number one, and then a different number three quarters. That is not right. It is ONE number, sitting at ONE spot on the number line. The little word and really means plus. One and three quarters means one whole plus three quarters, all glued together as a single amount.

visual.caption: Not two numbers — one single amount, a bit less than two wholes

steps.say: So remember, when you have more than one whole, count the wholes and the leftover pieces to get the mixed number, or count every single equal piece to get the improper fraction. Same amount, two ways to say it.

lesson.answer: More than one whole has two names: count wholes and leftovers for the mixed number, or count all the equal pieces for the improper fraction.

practice.question: Ms. Yuanyuan buys granola bars at the store, and each bar is scored into three equal pieces. Draw two fraction bars side by side, each one split into three equal parts. Now shade five pieces in total, starting from the left. What is this amount as a mixed number, and what is it as an improper fraction?
practice.answer: You shade all three pieces of the first bar and two pieces of the second bar. As a mixed number it is one and two thirds. As an improper fraction it is five thirds, because you shaded five one-third pieces in all.
